notice: Synthetic data for previewing NCDSync. No record describes a real person. Names are random pairings from common name lists, phone numbers all begin 0700 00, are not checked against any operator's allocation, and must never be dialled or sent an SMS, and every clinical value is invented. Clinical codes, medicine names and classification names follow the build prompt and carry the same draft status.

schema_notes.dates: Every 'day' is a whole-day offset from day 0, the calendar day on which demo data is switched on, in the facility time zone. Negative is the past. Times such as '08:12' are local times on that day. Day 0 must behave as a clinic day even at a weekend.
schema_notes.age: age_years_at_day_0 is an estimated age. Store the derived birth year with the estimated flag.
schema_notes.blood_pressure: bp is a list of [systolic, diastolic] readings. The visit blood pressure is their mean.
schema_notes.geography: Match district, sub-county and parish to the geography dataset where they exist. Where a name is not found, keep the district and store the remainder as village free text. Never fail a load on geography.
schema_notes.medicines: Names refer to the draft medicine list. No doses are given, by design. An entry that begins 'other:' is the list's 'other' item, with the rest of the string as its free text.
schema_notes.expect: Values the loaded record must produce. Use them as assertions. They are not inputs. review_due lists the review components of the person's condition modules that have never been recorded or were last recorded 12 months or more before day 0, in alphabetical order.
schema_notes.appointments: An appointment is created only by closing a visit that has next_appointment_day. appointment_day in a 'today' block and missed_appointment_day in a 'recall' block restate that appointment. Assert them; do not create a second appointment from them.
schema_notes.missing_fields: A baseline field that is absent was not recorded. Set the privacy notice acknowledgement time to the person's earliest registration day.
schema_notes.entered_by: No record names who entered it. Label nurse parts with the triage_nurse actor, clinician parts, reviews and events with the clinician actor, and recall calls with the registry_officer actor.
schema_notes.registry_numbers: The DEMO- series is reserved. The live number sequence must never issue it.

safety_rules: Load only while the facility is not approved for patient data. Refuse go-live approval while any synthetic record exists.
Every person loaded carries is_synthetic = true and a DEMO- registry number.
Never dispatch an SMS to a synthetic person, whatever transport is configured. Demo patients still appear on the recall list. Show their phone numbers with a do-not-call label and no dial link.
Removal deletes only records that belong to synthetic persons and must refuse any other person id.
Indicator values are always computed by the indicator engine from loaded records. Never write an indicator value directly.
Exports made while demo data is on are marked synthetic. The DHIS2 and FHIR exports refuse to run.
A monthly report cannot be signed while demo data is on.

generator.registered_by_condition_note: Targets within 2 percent, not exact counts. The registered total of 1,284 includes the scenario patients and every condition.
generator.other_modules_note: Totals across the registry, counting the scenario patients MK, RA, LN and TO. Every generated registration in these modules is added to a generated person who already holds a hypertension or diabetes registration. Each such person's visits carry a clinician-recorded control status and the module's observations.

name_pools.note: Random pairings for generated persons. Never pair to reproduce a scenario patient's full name.

generator.phone_pattern: 0700 00N NNN, unique per generated person, never reusing a scenario patient's number

monthly_in_range_percent.note: Twelve complete months, oldest first. The last value is the month before day 0. Each value is the share the indicator engine should report for that month: C04 for hypertension and C07 for diabetes, whose denominators include patients with no visit. Set the per-visit probabilities needed to produce it.

calibration_targets.note: Measured by the real indicator engine for the last complete month. A load outside tolerance fails the calibration test; adjust generator probabilities, never the indicator code.
